name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
archDisplay: Mixture-of-Experts (284B total / 13B active), hybrid Compressed Sparse Attention + Heavily Compressed Attention — retrained checkpoint of DeepSeek-V4-Flash on the same architecture
note: Retrained checkpoint of DeepSeek-V4-Flash published July 31, 2026, same 284B/13B architecture and API pricing as the April siblings. DeepSeek's own model card only reruns the launch-day agentic/coding table (Terminal-Bench 2.1, NL2Repo, CyberGym, DeepSWE) with an unreleased internal harness ('DeepSeek Harness'); general reasoning/knowledge benchmarks were not rerun and still carry April Preview values, so this row is coding/agentic-only evidence, not a full refresh. DeepSeek retired V4 Flash on Sep 10, 2026; the deepseek-v4-flash name now routes to V4.1-Flash.

results.notes: Terminal-Bench 2.1, DeepSeek official model card launch table, evaluated with an unreleased internal DeepSeek Harness (minimal mode); vs. 61.8 for the April Preview checkpoint on the same 2.1 suite.
NL2Repo, official model card launch table; vs. 39.4 for the April Preview checkpoint.
CyberGym, DeepSeek official model card launch table; vs. 38.7 for the April Preview checkpoint.
DeepSWE, DeepSeek official model card launch table; vs. 7.9 for the April Preview checkpoint (DeepSWE was not one of the benchmarks that carried over well between versions).
